Home.headline: Find the right <mark>help</mark> — or your next job.
Home.subhead: A marketplace connecting people who need a service with people who provide it, across Lebanon.
Home.bullet1: Every category has a transparent match score
Home.bullet2: Message anyone directly — your phone number stays private
Home.bullet3: Nannies, nursing, tutoring, home maintenance and delivery & errands are all live now
Home.step1Body: Tell us what you need or what you offer — it takes a few minutes.
Home.step2Body: A weighted match score ranks location, schedule, experience and more.
Home.step3Body: Message your matches in the app — your phone number stays private unless you choose to share it.

Featured.title: Get Featured
Featured.subtitle: Everything on ouiKnow is free — browsing, matching and messaging. Featured is optional: it puts your profile at the top of everyone's dashboard, regardless of match score.
Featured.perk1: Your profile appears first, above the scored matches, for every person of the other role
Featured.perk2: A visible Featured badge on your card
Featured.perk3: More visibility, not a better match score — the matching stays honest
Featured.step1: Send the amount by Whish to
Featured.step2: In the transfer note, put your account email:
